maker: (bell sec. only) Francesco Domenico Grigoletti, Klagenfurt
signature: "FRANCESCO DOMENICO GRIGOLETTI. CLAGENFURTI ANNO 1678." Stamped on garland: “41 322”
remarks: This instrument is quite suspicious. The proximal section of the instrument has been fitted with three Vienna valves. The bell opening is abnormally large for a seventeenth-century bass trombone, let alone a tenor, and the inscription on the bell is atypical of seventeenth-century work. Examined by the author, June 1999.
